uncertainties.title: Inventory records differ by €9,000
uncertainties.detail: Roll-forward: 80,000 + 459,000 − 405,000 − 22,000 = 112,000. Count: 79,000 + 42,000 = 121,000. The base follows explicit consumption, without inserting a reconciling entry.
uncertainties.impact: Count-led alternative changes COGS to 396,000, inventory to 121,000 and profit to 74,000. A different source error could instead affect opening equity or purchases.
uncertainties.action: Obtain a dated inventory movement ledger and repeat the count; identify the actual source error.

uncertainties.title: Insurance evidence is missing

uncertainties.impact: Unquantified. Expense reduces profit; balance-sheet impact depends on whether it consumes a prepaid asset or creates a payable.
uncertainties.action: Obtain the insurance policy and opening/prepaid schedule before certification.

uncertainties.title: Opening balances are incomplete
uncertainties.detail: AR 35,000 is assumed exhausted by the old-customer receipt. AP 45,000 is inferred from purchases, payments and confirmed closing creditors. Opening equity 170,000 is a residual under these assumptions.
uncertainties.impact: The 531,000 balance sheet and 125,000 closing equity balance conditionally, not as independently verified opening records.
uncertainties.action: Obtain the 1 January trial balance and supporting AR/AP ledgers.

uncertainties.detail: Counsel’s best estimate is 25,000 for a probable existing obligation; use that amount and disclose the range.

uncertainties.action: Update the estimate with counsel as the claim develops.

uncertainties.title: Disposal quote is not proof of an obligation
uncertainties.detail: Unsaleable stock is written off in full. The separate 2,000 quote alone does not establish a present legal or constructive obligation, so the base has no disposal provision.
uncertainties.impact: If an existing obligation is established: profit/equity fall 2,000, liabilities rise 2,000; cash remains unchanged. Forecast 2,000 future cash outflow.
uncertainties.action: Check legal requirements and any existing commitment before recognizing a provision.

uncertainties.title: Depreciation detail is unavailable

uncertainties.action: Obtain and recalculate the underlying fixed-asset depreciation schedule.

uncertainties.title: Monthly payroll cannot be separated
uncertainties.detail: All eight monthly decisions point to the same 231,000 aggregate bank payment. The payroll file supplies only departments.
uncertainties.impact: The total 248,000 expense and 32,000 payable reconcile. Monthly cash figures remain unknown.
uncertainties.action: Obtain January–August payroll registers; do not allocate evenly without evidence.

uncertainties.title: Routine expense timing and debt maturity need records
uncertainties.detail: Routine operating costs use cash paid as provisional expense. Debt principal 131,000 is verified, but the repayment maturity split is absent.
uncertainties.impact: Prepayments/accruals could change profit. A reliable current ratio cannot be asserted without debt maturity dates.
uncertainties.action: Obtain supplier invoices, subscription periods and loan amortization schedule.

uncertainties.title: Product margins and earn-out terms are absent
uncertainties.detail: Liberty product mix and allocated segment costs are not provided. No earn-out formula or liability contract is supplied.
uncertainties.impact: Core operations can be continued conditionally, but product profitability and an earn-out amount cannot be certified. The 247,000 difference from claimed profit is not a proven journal bridge.
uncertainties.action: Build segment contribution reporting and inspect the acquisition agreement before valuation.

boardRecommendation.recommendation: Continue core operations conditionally. Protect cash, resolve the evidence gaps, and defer unconditional valuation or earn-out approval.
boardRecommendation.summary: Revenue of €960,000 and provisional profit of €65,000 support a functioning business, but €60,000 cash is less than €90,000 in deposits for undelivered work and €126,000 owed to suppliers. The €139,000 operating inflow includes those €90,000 deposits. Owner withdrawals of €110,000 consumed liquidity.
boardRecommendation.valuation: Reject the unsupported €312,000 management profit. The €247,000 gap from the provisional reconstruction is a comparison, not an additive correction bridge. Obtain the earn-out contract and corrected source records before calculating a payment.
